name: Mosaic
description: Mosaic mines phosphate rock and potash and turns them into crop nutrients (phosphate and potash fertilizer) and animal feed ingredients. It is the world's second-largest producer of concentrated phosphate and second-largest phosphate rock miner (the largest in the US), per its 10-K. Products are global commodities sold on delivered price, so profit is the gap between fertilizer prices and input costs (ammonia, sulfur, natural gas) times tonnes. It runs its own distribution system (warehouses, ports and blending plants in Brazil, Paraguay, China and India) and a Brazilian segment (Mosaic Fertilizantes) that buys and blends fertilizer for Brazilian farmers, which earns a distribution margin rather than a mining margin. In 2025 potash, not phosphate, was the profit engine: about 61% of segment operating earnings from 22% of sales.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not re-checked against MSCI/S&P. SEC SIC 2870 (Agricultural Chemicals).

employees.note: 9,914 salaried and 3,335 hourly, incl. about 719 salaried at the 75%-owned Miski Mayo mine (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Phosphate
businessLines.how: Sells fertilizer tonnes at market prices set globally; margin is fertilizer price minus purchased ammonia and sulfur and rock cost. Buys about two-thirds of its North American ammonia on the open market.
businessLines.description: Florida phosphate rock mines and chemical plants making concentrated phosphates (DAP, MAP, MicroEssentials) and feed phosphates; also 75% of the Miski Mayo mine in Peru and Louisiana ammonia.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating earnings before corporate/eliminations/other (-$228.6M); share computed against the $1,050.1M sum of the three segments

businessLines.marketShare: second-largest producer of concentrated phosphate and second-largest phosphate rock miner in the world, largest in the US (company statement; no percent given)

businessLines.name: Potash
businessLines.how: Sells potassium chloride to farmers and industry at global prices; low-cost Canadian mines, so margin is high. Pays Canadian resource taxes ($272.8M in 2025: gross margin $870.0M before them $1,142.8M).
businessLines.description: Potash mines in Saskatchewan, Canada (plus Carlsbad, New Mexico, being sold).

operatingProfit.note: segment operating earnings before corporate/eliminations/other (-$228.6M); share computed against the $1,050.1M sum of the three segments

businessLines.name: Mosaic Fertilizantes (Brazil)
businessLines.how: Buys and sells fertilizer to Brazilian farmers and distributors; earns a distribution and blending margin (10.1% gross margin) on the largest revenue line of the company.
businessLines.description: Brazilian phosphate and potash based crop nutrient production, blending and distribution, including animal feed and five Brazilian phosphate rock mines and chemical plants.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating earnings before corporate/eliminations/other (-$228.6M); share computed against the $1,050.1M sum of the three segments

brands.name: MicroEssentials
brands.note: Performance phosphate product the 10-K names as a competitive advantage

brands.name: Miski Mayo (Peru phosphate mine, 75% owned, consolidated)
